_README: Drop one image per species here, named by the slug below. Any of .jpg .jpeg .png .webp works. refresh.py base64-embeds whatever it finds, so the published page stays self-contained; species with no file fall back to the drawn plate. Fill in credit/license/source for each file you add — the board renders the credit under the tile and lists it in Notes.

_sources_that_are_free_to_use.USFWS National Digital Library: https://digitalmedia.fws.gov — public domain, includes the Duane Raver fish plates
_sources_that_are_free_to_use.Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org — check each file's licence; CC-BY needs the credit filled in below
